newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 29.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
The Sydney Morning Herald reported on Wednesday that the building materials group is poised to raise A$1.0 billion from a shake-up of its Australian timber andU.S. construction business.
Metal recycler announced 43 percent fall in profit for the six months to December 31, 1996 on Tuesday citing lower demand and lower prices.

Seven served a notice on Optus Vision on Tuesday in a move that could lead to the television network buying Optus Vision, a pay television operator for about 85 percent of the value given by Optus Vision shareholders.
The bank's chief executive David Airey resigned on Tuesday and would take up the position of managing director of the New Zealand operations of the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd.

Crown announced on Tuesday it was negotiating with the casino's manager and major Shareholder, Hudson Conway, to buy the management rights to the Crown casino in Melbourne and that shareholders would vote on Hudson lifting its Crown stake through the exercise of options.
